question: Can the existing local Vision3-labelled raster corpus provide an independent, rights-cleared and nuisance-controlled real-film observation for BU4?
forbidden: open or hash image payloads before the metadata and rights gate passes
infer author, roll, process, scanner or stock identity from captions, filenames, directories or appearance
treat CineStill or other repackaged/remjet-modified material as exact VISION3 without explicit material provenance
repair missing rights or lineage by web guessing or source-content clustering
train, fit, render or promote from a failed source gate

branch_rule.pass: Open a separately frozen integrity and nuisance audit before any pixel-derived statistic.
branch_rule.fail: Quarantine this exact local corpus from BU4 validation and seek a genuinely controlled independent observation.

claim_ceiling: Metadata and rights eligibility of the existing local Vision3-labelled corpus only; no pixel, stock-response, appearance, calibration or product evidence.
